designSystem: Portrait editorial infographics in a classic physical 16-bit pixel-art style. Dark charcoal/navy background, neon-lime pathways, cobalt-blue USDC elements, warm gold yield accents, crisp white type, exact Propbase logo placed visibly in a contrasting lower corner. Each panel must explain one mechanism visually and remain distinct from the others.

prompts.headline: BORROW WITHOUT SELLING?
prompts.concept: A property token remains visibly held while a parallel pathway unlocks USDC; rental coins continue flowing from the property. Hero overview, not a generic crypto scene.

prompts.headline: ONE POOL • TWO SIDES
prompts.concept: Two-sided market: property-token borrowers on one side, USDC suppliers on the other, connected through a single shared pool with directional arrows.

prompts.headline: STAKE • PLEDGE • BORROW
prompts.concept: Three-stage process infographic: stake the eligible property token, pledge it as collateral, receive USDC while property ownership exposure remains visible.

prompts.headline: COLLATERAL KEEPS EARNING
prompts.concept: A locked property token still produces a clearly separate stream of rental-yield coins while a loan position remains open.

prompts.headline: A DIFFERENT LIQUIDATION MODEL
prompts.concept: Split comparison: conventional crypto collateral approaching an automated sell trigger versus pledged property tokens without an automatic price-triggered sale engine; communicate difference without implying no risk.

prompts.headline: FOUR LIMITS • ONE ANSWER
prompts.concept: Four constraint gauges—property LTV, membership allowance, exposure limit, pool liquidity—converge on the tightest binding borrowing limit.

prompts.headline: UTILISATION SETS THE RATE
prompts.concept: Pool utilisation rises through stepped tiers; the active tier locks with a padlock when the loan opens, while more borrowing or repayment can shift the position.

prompts.headline: REPAY ON YOUR TERMS
prompts.concept: A branching decision tree with full repayment, partial principal reduction and interest-only payment; collateral tiles unlock proportionally as principal falls.

prompts.headline: SUPPLY USDC • EARN INTEREST
prompts.concept: Several human suppliers add USDC to one pool; capital routes to property-backed loans; gold interest flows back through a transparent earnings mechanism.

prompts.headline: AVAILABLE NOW VS DEPLOYED
prompts.concept: A transparent reservoir separates liquid USDC available for immediate withdrawal from capital deployed into active loans, with repayments returning liquidity.

prompts.headline: MY POSITIONS • ONE VIEW
prompts.concept: A unified pixel dashboard links property collateral, debt, interest, earnings, pool share and PROPS rewards around one central portfolio terminal.
